outputs.description: Polarization degrees for Na D₂ and Hg resonance lines computed from Zeeman selection rules.

output_contract.notes: Both polarization degrees are derived from the Zeeman splitting of the relevant atomic levels and the electric-dipole selection rules (Δm = 0, ±1) under the specified experimental geometry. The Hg resonance line involves a single allowed transition and thus yields a different polarization than the Na D₂ line.
